title: dock on second display wont display icons

pending_author.requested_evidence: Confirm that Dock is enabled for the non-primary monitor, that the secondary dock was opened with Edit Dock, and that bands such as PC vitals were pinned there before concluding it still fails.

judgment.rationale: The latest maintainer response explains the intended secondary-monitor Dock behavior and asks the reporter to confirm whether they enabled and customized the secondary dock; the issue also carries Needs-Author-Feedback.
evidence: Reporter says PC vitals/icons show on the primary monitor but not on the second display.
The report has no bug report ZIP and only a screenshot-level reproduction.
The issue is currently labeled Needs-Author-Feedback.
On 2026-09-08 michaeljolley asked whether the reporter enabled Dock for the non-primary monitor and then used Edit Dock to pin content.
Current DockMultiMonitorTests assert that new secondary monitors start with empty StartBands, CenterBands, and EndBands.
judgment.recommended_action: Wait for the reporter to confirm whether they enabled and customized the secondary dock, and whether the blank dock persists after pinning bands.

fix_assessment.rationale: A PowerToys code fix is not currently applicable because current evidence matches intentional blank-secondary-dock behavior unless the reporter confirms customization still fails.

issue_context.summary: The reporter expects PC vitals/icons to appear automatically on a secondary-monitor Command Palette Dock. The latest maintainer comment explains that secondary docks are created without preconfigured bands and asks the reporter to confirm whether they enabled the secondary dock and customized it through Edit Dock.
known_information: Issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Author-Feedback, Needs-Triage, and Product-Command Palette.
Reporter supplied PowerToys version value 0.11.11762.0, Microsoft Store installation, Windows 11, and no bug report ZIP.
Reporter says the Dock displays content on the primary monitor but not on the second monitor.
Maintainer michaeljolley stated that non-primary monitor docks have no preconfigured bands and must be customized via right-click > Edit Dock.
The issue has no PowerToys project item returned by the live issue query.
inferences: The report likely describes expected secondary-dock initialization rather than a confirmed rendering failure.
If the reporter already pinned bands on the secondary dock and they still do not render, the issue would need a new bug report ZIP and settings context.
issue_context.analysis: The latest maintainer comment is a direct author-feedback request, and current source/test evidence supports the explanation: secondary monitors intentionally start with empty band lists. The correct dashboard state is waiting on the reporter rather than proposing a fix or repeating the maintainer request as a new upstream action.
initial_investigation: Read live issue body, labels, assignees, comments, timeline, and events for #50090.
Reviewed the new 2026-09-08 maintainer comment asking whether the reporter enabled and customized the secondary dock.
Inspected DockSettings.cs: global DockSettings define default StartBands and EndBands including PerformanceMonitor bands, while DockMonitorConfig stores per-monitor customized band lists.
Inspected DockMonitorConfigViewModel.cs: toggling IsCustomized forks global bands into a monitor-specific config, and clearing customization removes per-monitor bands.
Inspected DockMultiMonitorTests.cs: Reconciler_NewSecondaryMonitor_StartsWithEmptyBands asserts a new secondary monitor is customized with zero start, center, and end bands.

information_gaps.information: Whether the reporter enabled Dock on the non-primary monitor, used Edit Dock, pinned PC vitals or other bands to that monitor, and still observed a blank dock.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes intentional empty secondary-dock defaults from a real failure to render customized secondary-dock bands.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply to the maintainer comment with the exact secondary-dock settings/customization state; if it still fails after pinning bands, add a fresh /bugreport immediately after reproducing.
